end.parentNote: Manav practised grouping living things by what they eat and arranging a food chain. They explained the chain grass → deer → tiger and the arrow from deer to tiger. They initially placed grass first but were unsure what comes after the tiger; decomposers were mentioned later, though the teach-back was not completed. At home, ask Manav to draw one food chain and label the producer, plant-eater, and meat-eater.
